desc: Parse the pattern `p` to extract `prefix`, `middle`, and `suffix` strings. Handle edge cases where `prefix` or `suffix` or `middle` might be empty.
Find all starting indices of `prefix` in `s` and all ending indices of `suffix` in `s` (or starting indices of suffix). Store them in sorted lists.
Find all starting indices of `middle` in `s` and store them in a sorted list. If `middle` is empty, it is always present.

For each starting position `i` of `prefix`, determine the minimum length substring by finding the smallest `j` (end of suffix) such that the range `[i + len(prefix), j + len(suffix) - 1]` contains an occurrence of `middle`. Use binary search on the `middle` positions list to check feasibility.
Iterate through all valid combinations and track the minimum length found. Return the minimum length or -1 if no match exists.
